title: The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit
original_title: The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit
overview: On Halloween night, 1983, Jay and her friend group step into the abandoned Waterman House. What awaits them there is beyond their worst nightmares! Watch Jay (Izzplash), Dino (Martin Paredes) and their friends face off against the despicable Pumpkin Rabbit (Bravvy/Eva) and the intimidating Witch Sheep (-Lighth0use-) in The Return of The Pumpkin Rabbit: The Extended Version, now complete with scary Bonus scenes, additional content and the terrifying prologue: The Mysterious House! (Featuring Duckie and Tammy). All this in one horrifying package, brought to you by Bunny Smiles Incorporated.
